test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Amit sells an item for Rs. 614.25 after offering a discount of 25% on its marked price. Had he not offered the discount, he would have earned a profit of 17%. The cost price (in Rs.) of the item is:
solution:
**Formula used:**

Selling price = Marked price - discount %

Marked price = cost price + Profit %

**Calculation:**

Let Marked price to be = 100 %

Selling price = 100% - 25 %

⇒ 75 %

According to question,

Value of 75 % = 614.25

Value of 100 % = 614.25 × 100over 75 %

Marked price ( 100% ) = 819

⇒ 819 = cost price + profit %

⇒ 819 = 100 % + 17 %

⇒ 819 = 117 %

⇒100 % = 700

**∴ The cost price of the item = Rs. 700**
